description: How to reach one subhandle of the repository's account directly. Record key: the subhandle. Read with one getRecord(DID, computer.socialweb.peer, subhandle); never listed. A reader trusts the record only while its lease verifies: the market.association chain from the account up to its owner, every link unexpired and its contract Held. A stale record whose lease no longer verifies is ignored.

iroh.description: A short iroh ticket (node id and relay, no addresses) whose endpoint serves this account's XRPC directly.

webrtc.description: The DID whose repo answers computer.socialweb.ingress.offer records for this account.

channels.description: The atirc channels the subhandle is in.

lease.description: The contract-scoped market.association that names this account; the record is valid only while that association and its parents verify.
